The CTO will be responsible for building and scaling high-performing engineering teams, defining technology architecture and standards, overseeing software delivery and cloud infrastructure, strengthening cybersecurity, and ensuring that technology investments are aligned with the company's business objectives. The ideal candidate should combine strong technical depth with business leadership , with experience managing complex software projects, cloud platforms, engineering teams, client-facing technology engagements, and enterprise-scale systems.

Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities to improve business efficiency, service offerings, and competitive positioning. Establish engineering standards, architecture principles, development methodologies, and technology governance.
